subject: Native Android PoC UI prepared; first APK workflow ready to trigger
body: Under explicit human directive, Manager-01 designed the first native Android/Jetpack Compose BenefitFlow interface, ran three iterative local UI/state test passes with two enhancement cycles, and prepared a GitHub Actions debug-APK workflow. The Android PoC remains synthetic and preserves the live-integration/P0 safety boundary. The implementation commit is ready to fast-forward onto main, which will automatically trigger the first APK build.
